macros.name: gamemathtrue
macros.doc: \gamemathtrue: put all text in cells in payoff matrix in math mode.

macros.name: gamestretch
macros.doc: \gamestretch: a number that controls the spacing between rows, analogous to \arraystretch.

macros.name: gamevaligntrue
macros.doc: \gamevaligntrue: vertically align the text within cells of a tabular environment as they are aligned in a game environment.

macros.name: sglabelsep
macros.doc: \sglabelsep: vertical space between game and label.

macros.name: sgtextcolor
macros.doc: \sgtextcolor: color of text in game (action labels, payoffs, player labels).

macros.name: ssualtrue
macros.doc: \ssualtrue: stretch space under action labels when \gamestretch is greater than 1.
